Hi All,

For those who couldn't attend yesterday's product strategy meeting, I've uploaded the recording to our shared drive under "Meeting Recordings > Q3 Strategy." The recording includes the full discussion as well as the slides presented.

A few action items came out of the meeting, which I'll follow up on separately in a more detailed summary email later today. In the meantime, please watch the recording before our follow-up session next Tuesday.

Let me know if you have trouble accessing the file.

Thanks,
Omar

To reduce energy consumption, all office lighting will be upgraded to motion-sensor fixtures over the coming weeks. Lights will automatically turn on when someone enters a room and switch off after 15 minutes of no detected movement.

Employees working quietly at their desks, such as reading printed materials, may occasionally need to wave a hand to reactivate the lights if they turn off unexpectedly. We apologize in advance for any inconvenience during the adjustment period.

This upgrade is expected to reduce the building's overall energy usage by approximately 15 percent.
